# FNA 26.11

The client builds the managed FNA project from source. This directory contains the C# sources, bindings and effect resources that the upstream FNA.Core.csproj references. The project targets .NET 10 to match BRUTAL. The release archive SHA-256 is `6F48A205F32E2160032FC49E7CB0B0CFB820F5761D2A5AFEB01FCA894BD448D6`. [FNA 26.11 release](https://github.com/FNA-XNA/FNA/releases/tag/26.11)

The Windows x64 FNA3D, FAudio and SDL3 binaries come from upstream build 44246445383. The native archive SHA-256 is `6981869D31C63DEA57290BD321F2481A769D8053FBCB5DF9AF0297AB95CA920A`. [FNA native build](https://github.com/FNA-XNA/fnalibs-dailies/actions/runs/44246445383)

The upstream FNA license is in `licenses/LICENSE`. Notices for the distributed components ship in the player's `Content/Licenses` directory.
